scenes.heading: Building a personal brand alongside your business brand

sents.d: Building a personal brand alongside your business brand
People often trust a face before they trust a logo.

Especially for small and service-based businesses, content from a visible founder or team member often performs better and builds trust faster than purely brand-voice content with no visible person behind it.

scenes.heading: Share your reasoning now and then

sents.d: This doesn't require becoming an influencer — occasionally sharing your reasoning, process, or perspective alongside standard business content humanizes the brand without requiring a separate, constant personal content strategy.

Balance is worth being intentional about: enough personal visibility to build trust, without making the business entirely dependent on one person's presence, which can become a liability if that person steps back later.

take: Show a real person behind the brand, in balance.
